info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Rewards Management API
info.description: The Rewards Management API provides access to the rewards program associated with banking services, allowing users to retrieve detailed information about available rewards, their status, and eligibility criteria. This endpoint is designed for financial service providers and customer relationship management systems that aim to enhance user engagement through rewards offerings. Typical consumers include banks, credit unions, and fintech platforms that wish to integrate reward tracking and management into their applications. By leveraging this API, businesses can easily offer personalized reward experiences to their customers, driving loyalty and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows clients to fetch the current rewards available in the operational services. It provides essential details that can be used for user benefits and promotions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve operational service rewards. It should include the necessary parameters within the JSON structure to specify what rewards information is being requested.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returns the rewards data.

GetRewardsOperationalServicesRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on rewards operational services in JSON format.
